{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for duplicate order_id values
order_id_duplicates = df['order_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Check if any order_id appears more than once
order_id_counts = df['order_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_order_ids = order_id_counts[order_id_counts > 1]

order_id_duplicates, duplicate_order_ids"}
